system.description:
You lean into the caster's half of the hybrid: less committed to the blade, more willing to cast outright when the moment calls for it. A Battle Caster takes this Path in place of a kit.

  • Broader Study (1st): each time you gain access to a new spell level, add one Wizard-list spell of that level to your Spellblade list (not Polymorph; Haste on yourself only).
  • You still use the Spellblade's slots and DC.
  • After you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, your next weapon attack before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
  • Scholar's Standing (1st): Advantage on checks with wizards and mages' guilds, and on recalling arcane lore.
  • Caster's Guard (5th): Arcane Cascade also triggers when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, not only after a Spellstrike.
  • Spell Surge (10th): once per encounter, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher as your action, you may make one weapon attack with your bonded weapon as part of the same action.
